question: What is the meaning of human toxicity cancerogenic in relation to essential environmental characteristics?
description: Human toxicity, cancerogenic refers to the potential of a substance to cause cancer in humans. This is one of the predetermined environmental essential characteristics listed in the context information, specifically under (q) in the Annex II. It is important for assessing the potential health impacts of a product throughout its life cycle. However, due to ongoing debates and lack of broad consensus within the LCA community, there is currently no clear guidance on how to accurately incorporate this characteristic into life cycle assessments.
